gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed diagnosis of World Health Organization (WHO) classification grade IV glioblastoma (GBM).

candidate_evidence.quote: B7-H3-targeting CAR-T cells derived from patient own peripheral blood mononuclear cells will be given to patients via intracerebral injection though an Ommaya catheter

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Relapsed/refractory disease confirmed by radiographic evidence after standard therapy.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Peak Concentration (Cmax) of B7-H3 CAR-T in peripheral blood (PB) and cerebral spinal fluid (CSF)

role_evidence.quote: B7-H3-targeting CAR-T cells derived from patient own peripheral blood mononuclear cells will be given to patients via intracerebral injection though an Ommaya catheter

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: B7-H3 CAR-T, made from isolated patient peripheral blood mononuclear cells, can specifically attack patient glioblastoma cells that expressing B7-H3.

source_quote.quote: Clinical Pathology confirms B7-H3 positive tumor expression by immunohistochemistry (IHC) at the initial tumor presentation or recurrent disease (H-score \>= 50).

coder_notes: Only investigational agent is B7-H3 CAR-T (cell therapy, excluded type); temozolomide is in both arms (soc_backbone). B7-H3 eligibility biomarker is matched to the CAR-T target but CAR-T is not a candidate, so candidate_matched false. CAR-T levels in CSF are planned but CAR-T is not a candidate, so tumour_pk_planned no. 'WHO classification grade IV glioblastoma' cites no WHO edition and no IDH requirement; coded cns5_terminology unclear (Roman-numeral grade could suggest WHO 2016).
